picks.title: Ep. 383 - Dr. Lynne McNeill on 'Squatchy Lore and Legends!
picks.summary: Cliff Barackman and Matt Pruitt speak with folklorist Dr. Lynne McNeill about the intersection of folklore, science, and the sasquatch! Dr. McNeill is an Associate Professor of Folklore at Utah State University. Her research focuses on legend and belief, cryptids, digital culture, and the ways that folklore develops and spreads through communities. Dr. McNeill discusses what folklore actually is, why folklorists study it, and what traditional stories tell us about the world around us. picks.title: Fairies Were Never What We Imagined 🧚‍♀️🌙 | The Dark Truth Behind Fairy Folklore | Boring History for Sleep
picks.summary: We grew up with stories of tiny winged creatures, sparkling forests, magical wishes, and gentle fairies who helped lost travelers. But the fairies of ancient folklore were often far stranger — and much more dangerous — than the beautiful creatures of modern stories.What did people once believe fairies really were? Why were they feared as much as they were admired? And how did mysterious spirits, supernatural beings, and old folk beliefs eventually become the charming fairies we know today?A calm journey into the forgotten world of fairy folklore, exploring ancient beliefs, strange encounters,
picks.reason: Examines the darker, original meanings of fairy folklore beyond modern portrayals.
